label: agent loop • change two paragraphs in an existing .docx with file_edit (no regenerate, no shell)
query: In memo.docx, change the status line from Draft to Final and move the go-live date from April 14 to April 21. Leave every other paragraph exactly as it is.
notes: file_edit on a .docx replaces paragraph text in place (old_string/new_string or a replace_text operation). Regenerating with file_write would drop the memo's heading and list styles; the command assertions prove both edits landed, the old values are gone, and untouched paragraphs plus the ListParagraph style survive.

commands.command: unzip -p memo.docx word/document.xml | grep -q 'Support staffing during cutover.'
